newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans fall amid fresh Brazil import rumors.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans fall amid fresh Brazil import rumors.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were sharply lower and the May and July contracts were in fast dealings amid rumors U.S. firms had purchased up to five cargoes of Brazilian soybeans for import, traders said.
Glencore Brazil confirmed on Wednesday it had sold 45,000 tonnes of soybeans to a U.S. firm but traders cited reports that five times as much had been sold. No confirmation was immediately available.
There were also reports from Brazilian traders that another firm was negotiating to sell soymeal to a U.S. buyer.
Floor sources said Griffin Trading sold at least one million bushels May soybeans and Refco Inc sold at least one million May and July.
Stops were hit below $8.25 per bushel in the May, prompting local selling, traders said.
At 1242 CST, soybeans were down 9-1/2 to three cents per bushel with May off 9-1/2 at $8.19.
